title: Legacy Serial
text: Read input data for baseboard serial communications, 1 output, {Output Datatype} sets Select output data type 8 bit uint null; {Serial port} sets the port that is being accessed Legacy Serial, {Max Read Count} selects maximum word read count and {SampleTime} selects sample time. Values come from the instance.
